added_findings.title: QR Symbol and Sheet Images Setup fail OPEN to NA addresses when their config cannot be read

In VV a config fetch failure (offline, a stale service-worker copy, Flask's catch-all answering a missing file with index.html) would therefore draw a code addressed to NA's resolver on a Vale drawing - even with ProjectQr__Enabled:false in the shipped JSON. Sheet Images Setup has the same pattern: fallback Sources PagesBaseUrl https://www.noble-architecture.com (Setup__.js:184), so a VV viewer would fetch pictures from the NA site. TV fails open by design (its resolver exists); VV must not.

Record each as a PORT NOTE divergence and add an acceptance test with the QR config unreadable.

added_findings.title: VV renames projects live (worker moves the R2 folder and rewrites the index entry): QR keys and resolver must survive it
added_findings.detail: VV's worker route POST /api/editor/projects/{folderId}/rename (CloudflareHandler__ProjectRename__.js) copies every object under VaApps/Projects/{old}/ to {new}, deletes the old ones, and patches the master index entry's folderId, year, name and projectCode (code from project.json, else the new folder name; :300-304) via CloudflareHelper__MasterIndexR2__.js; Flask has the matching /api/projects/<old>/rename route (server.py:560). TV's resolver keys on NA codes that never change. In VV a printed key based on folderId or folder name breaks on the first rename; projectCode is shared by 13 schemes and can be rewritten. Pictures under LayoutEditor/SheetImages/ move with the folder (fine); the register's browser draft key follows the token. The survey did not locate the index writers: they are WCP/Tools__DevUtils/AutomationUtil__R2Common__Lib__.py (na_make_index_entry, na_index_upsert_project, na_index_write, na_index_rebuild_all) and the worker helper above.
added_findings.recommendation: Decide D-S07a-14: a permanent qrKey field in each master index entry, written once by the Python index writer and preserved by the rename handler; the Vale resolver (WP-S07a-05) reads it (possibly straight from the existing master index on the CDN with the GitHub copy as fallback, instead of a second generated index). Add 'rename a scratch project; its printed key still resolves' to WP-05's acceptance.
added_findings.evidence: CloudflareHandler__ProjectRename__.js header :8-31 and :300-304; CloudflareHelper__MasterIndexR2__.js :58-118; AutomationUtil__R2Common__Lib__.py :21-22, 63, 298-401; server.py:560.

added_findings.title: TV's open Sheet Images gap carries over: pictures in Custom Scrapbook items or pasted across projects point at the source project's file

added_decisions.question: Where does ValeVision's document code - the {project} of a Document ID, <code>_REGISTER, <code>_SPEC, the PDF names and the picture folders - come from, given Na__DrawData__GetProjectCode() is the ?project= token (2026/3047__Doous when opened from the gallery)?
added_decisions.options: A a VV accessor returning the loaded project.json projectCode (numeric, present in all 155 local project files), handed over by the loading sequence; B keep GetProjectCode() (the token: folderId, folder name or code depending on the link); C a new per-project documentCode field
added_decisions.recommendation: A, used by SheetRecords (DocumentId and the DrawingNumber default), Register__Pdf, PdfExporter and SpecPdf, with GetProjectCode() kept as the transport token. It also fixes today's VV title blocks printing '2026/3047__Doous-01' on unnumbered sheets.

added_decisions.question: What key does a printed ValeVision QR code carry, given VV renames projects live (the worker moves VaApps/Projects/{old}/ to {new} and rewrites the master index entry's folderId, year, name and projectCode)?
added_decisions.options: A projectCode (13 are shared by schemes, and a rename can rewrite it); B folderId or folder name (changes on rename; a version 5 symbol at 0.244 mm); C a permanent qrKey field in each master index entry, written once by AutomationUtil__R2Common__Lib__.py and preserved by CloudflareHandler__ProjectRename__.js
added_decisions.recommendation: C - the NA resolver can key on PS01 only because NA codes never change.

notes: The S07a survey was high quality: every factual claim I opened (versions, line references, devlog and ledger citations, the 152/13 master-index figures, the three VV projects with sheets, the QR byte budget, the yellow/amber TV defect, the header gaps) checked out, and nothing was refuted. Its weaknesses are VV-side behaviours it did not exercise and cross-slice sequencing. Most important for the swarm: (1) VV's 'project code' is the ?project= token, which Whitecardopedia always sets to the full folderId, so a verbatim v2.71.0 port prints '2026/3047__Doous_T01_D01' everywhere. WP-S07a-01 needs the new document-code accessor (WP-S07a-09, D-S07a-13) first, and VV already leaks the token into unnumbered title blocks and SpecPdf numbers today. (2) The QR Symbol and Sheet Images Setup fail open to NA addresses when their JSON is unreadable, so 'Enabled:false' alone is not a safe ship state; fail closed plus BaseUrl ''. (3) The QR and picture render leaves must land before S03b's and S08's whole-file hub ports (WP-S07a-10). The editing modules form a cycle with S05a/S06a's PointerPress, ContextMenu and Toolbar ports and S04b's ObjectSnap shim, so schedule them in one wave or seam the picture lines. (4) The transport facade is the same thing as S09's same-name shims (D-S09-04/WP-S09-06): build it once, and use a ?t=+no-store CDN read for 'fresh R2', never FetchProjectJson (memoised, build-token cached). (5) project.json folderId/displayName are unreliable (missing or stale in 64 of 155 files), and VV renames projects live, so QR keys need a permanent index field (D-S07a-14). Corrections were also made to F05 (RenumberSheets conflicts with S03b's no-op rule; decided by D-S07a-01), F37 (Setup is port_adapted), F38/F39/F50 (Na__LeOsnap names exist in VV's Snapping__.js), F16 (missing the 'register-updated' chrome refresh) and F20 (WebViewer register entry belongs to S08). The executive summary's '58 named imports' are 58 import statements (37 distinct missing names). The report was edited in place, with a '## Verification' section appended, and a pre-verification backup is at scratchpad/parity/verify_s07a/S07a_report_before_verify.md. Unverified: runtime behaviour, live R2, GitHub Pages serving a new VCB/q/, and the bodies of the picture editing modules beyond their imports and NA strings.
